name: read.ts
title: read.matrix, then a time series with the given start and frequency.

origin.description: read.matrix, then a time series with the given start and frequency.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The series, matrix, or path this function accepts.

origin.details: read.matrix, then a time series with the given start and frequency.
origin.value: The same value tseries 0.10-63 returns for this case, written as one line.
origin.example:
tmp <- "/tmp/tseries-read-ts.txt"
cat("a b\n1.5 2.5\n3.5 4.5\n", file = tmp)
ts <- read.ts(tmp, header = TRUE, start = 1990, frequency = 4)
paste(join(as.numeric(ts)), paste(vapply(tsp(ts), cell, ""), collapse = ","), sep = "|")

translation.description: read.matrix, then a time series with the given start and frequency.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The series, matrix, or path this function accepts.

translation.details: read.matrix, then a time series with the given start and frequency.
translation.value: The same value tseries 0.10-63 returns for this case, written as one line.
translation.example:
path = Path("/tmp/tseries-read-ts.txt")
path.write_text("a b\n1.5 2.5\n3.5 4.5\n")
values, start, freq = read_ts(path, header=True, start=1990, frequency=4)
end = start + (values.shape[0] - 1) / freq
return join(np.ravel(values, order="F")) + "|" + ",".join([cell(start), cell(end), cell(freq)])
